name: Ijikuri Mama 3
source:
Azusa's husband is away from home for a few weeks on business. With him gone she's sexually frustrated. While visiting her friend [url=https://vndb.org/c31454]Haruno Tamami[/url] she and her son Kaede see her having sex with her son Hizashi. Running away in a hurry they go to her friend [url=https://vndb.org/c31453]Aizawa Misaki[/url] and catch her having sex with her son Ayumu.

Not understanding the feelings he has by what he's seen Kaede asks his mother for help. She offers to teach him with her body.
translation:
梓的丈夫因公出差，几周都不在家。丈夫离开后，她感到欲求不满。梓去拜访朋友[url=https://vndb.org/c31454]春野珠美[/url]时，和儿子枫撞见珠美正在与儿子日差发生性关系。他们慌忙逃走，前往珠美的朋友[url=https://vndb.org/c31453]相泽美咲[/url]家，却又撞见美咲正在与儿子步发生性关系。

枫无法理解自己目睹这些事情后产生的感情，于是向母亲求助。梓决定用自己的身体教导他。
